params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: migration_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the migration.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Exclude attributes from the API response to improve performance

items.docs:
Fetches the status of a migration.

The `state` of a migration can be one of the following values:

*   `pending`, which means the migration hasn't started yet.
*   `exporting`, which means the migration is in progress.
*   `exported`, which means the migration finished successfully.
*   `failed`, which means the migration failed.

info.name: GitHub Get List of Conflicting Packages During Docker Migration for Organization

params.name: org
params.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

items.docs:
Lists all packages that are in a specific organization, are readable by the requesting user, and that encountered a conflict during a Docker migration.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `read:packages` scope to use this endpoint.
